deviations.what: Featured 32% discount + promo code section omitted
deviations.why: No promotion model exists in the Vitrina data/product; inventing discounts violates the truth contract.
The product has no booking flow; a fake form would be non-functional.
Team rendering requires REAL_OWNER_PERSON data, which is not available.

deviations.what: Three branch address columns replaced with d.AREAS in the footer
deviations.why: The data contract exposes only AREAS as a string, not structured branch locations.

deviations.what: Original 'Hurry Up!' urgency and promo code removed
deviations.why: Unsupported urgency/promo patterns are not part of the Vitrina system.
Only the listed self-hosted fonts are available; Fira Sans Condensed + Anton were chosen for a similar display character.

notes: Fixed --vt-ink-soft to #6e6f72 so contrast on --vt-surface-2 (#f0f8ff) reaches ≈4.68:1, passing the 4.5:1 requirement. The theme preserves the fixed mustard sidebar, hero gradient overlay, circular hero card (repurposed as a phone CTA), image service cards with price pills, dotted price rows, and the accent hours card.
